sentences.text:
Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.10285 of 2025
Order:

This writ petition has been filed to declare the action of the respondent No.2 herein in not referring the Award No.Nil/2015- 16, File No.B/13/2009-I-Abadi, dated Nil.02.2016 pertaining to the petitioner's property/structure bearing H.No.1-20 and 1-21, situated at Cheerlavancha Village,
Sircilla Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District (subject property) under Section 64 of Act 30 of 2013 to the LARR Authority, Hyderabad for enhancement of compensation pursuant to the application dated 25.05.2016 as illegal and arbitrary and consequently direct respondent No.2 to refer the above said award for enhancement of compensation in terms of application dated 25.05.2016.
2.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondents.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Government had proposed to construct Mid Manair by acquiring agriculture lands and dwelling houses/structures.

The subject ::2::
property of the petitioner has also been acquired on 20.01.2011 without giving any prior notice.
According to General Award dated Nil.02.2016, petitioner was awarded an amount of Rs.21,49,387/- (for H.No.1-20) and Rs.10,53,272/- (for H.No.1- 21).
The main grievance of the petitioner is that respondent authorities have wrongly calculated the dwelling area and structure value of the petitioner's property and undervalued the same.
In that regard, petitioner has made a representation on 25.05.2016.
As there was no response forthcoming, the petitioner is before this Court by way of this writ petition.

4. Though various grounds are raised in the writ petition, learned counsel for the petitioner restricts his prayer seeking a direction to respondent authorities to dispose of the petitioner's representation dated 13.04.2016 in a time bound period.

5. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submits that if the said representation is still pending for consideration, the respondent authorities may be directed to dispose of the petitioner's representation, dated 25.05.2016 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

::3: :
6. In view of the submission made by the learned counsel on either side and without going into the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of directing the Ummareddy Bharathi vs State Of Telangana on 4 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124002844/
